task.title: Parity: a line with length 0 and no data gives a message
task.body:
A line with a length of 0 and no data gives a message. canboat skips it with `skipping malformed input line: line ends after the length field; no payload section`.

```
2020-08-22T13:52:43.993Z,7,65301,255,0,0
2016-04-09T16:41:09.092Z,3,126208,32,255,0
```

canboatjs gives `{"data":""}` for the first and an empty 126208 for the second. A message with no data doesn't exist on the bus. These come from a logger that wrote a broken line.

Also lenient: `2022-04-17-04:35:34.254,4,129551,3,255,20,…,10,00,0,0c,…`, which has a one-digit byte. canboat refuses the line, and canboatjs reads it.
